For accessible ramps 3000 mm or more in width, provide intermediate handrails at the center. The use of double “J-type” handrail supports is recommended. - 10. Accessible ramps with a total length longer than 10.50m shall be provided with intermediate landings with a minimum length of 1800 mm. 1. Landing served by a doorway shall conform to the requirements as provided under Clear Level Space for Doors. - 11. Level area not less than 1800 mm at the upper end and lower end of any ramp. - 12. Handrails on both sides of the ramp at 700 mm and 900 mm from the ﬁnished ﬂoor of the ramp to the top of the handrails. - 13. 300 mm horizontal extension of the handrail shall be provided at the upper end and lower end of ramps. - 14. Raised edge on both sides of the ramp with a minimum height of 100 mm. - 15. Ramps shall be provided with tactile warning strips at the head, foot, and landings. The warning tactile blocks shall have a depth of 600 mm and shall be installed: - 1. 300 mm from the head and foot of the ramp and, - 2. at the center of each landing - 16.
